column2:
magical(adj.)神奇的、魔法的、迷人的
magic(n./adj.)魔術、魔法
magician(n.)魔術師
magical power 魔力
magical moment 美妙的時刻
The night view of the city was magical.
(這座城市的夜景美得令人著迷。)
In the story, the old woman has magical powers.
(故事中，那位老婦人擁有魔力。)

magician(n.)魔術師、魔法師
magic(n.)魔術、魔法
magical(adj.)神奇的
street magician 街頭魔術師
a famous magician 知名魔術師
The magician pulled a rabbit out of his hat.
(那位魔術師從帽子裡拉出一隻兔子。)
Louis Liu is a famous magician from Taiwan.
(劉謙是台灣有名的魔術師。)

magnet(n.)磁鐵、有吸引力的人(事物)
magnetic(adj.)有磁性的、有吸引力的
fridge magnet 冰箱磁鐵
a magnet for 吸引…的地方
She put a photo on the fridge with a magnet.
(她用磁鐵把照片貼在冰箱上。)
The night market is a magnet for tourists.
(夜市是吸引觀光客的地方。)

maid(n.)女僕、女傭
(無詞性變化)
hotel maid 飯店清潔人員
maid of honor 伴娘
The hotel maid cleans our room every morning.
(飯店清潔人員每天早上打掃我們的房間。)
My cousin asked me to be her maid of honor.
(我表姊請我當她的伴娘。)

majority(n.)大多數、多數
major(adj.)主要的
the majority of 大多數的…
majority vote 多數決
The majority of students voted for the class trip.
(大多數學生投票贊成班級旅行。)
We made the decision by majority vote.
(我們以多數決做出決定。)

mall(n.)購物中心、商場
(無詞性變化)
shopping mall 購物中心
go to the mall 去逛街
Let's go to the mall this weekend.
(這個週末我們去購物中心逛逛吧。)
The new shopping mall has a big movie theater.
(新的購物中心有一間大電影院。)

mankind(n.)人類
humankind(n.)人類(性別中立的說法)
human(n./adj.)人、人類的
the history of mankind 人類歷史
for the good of mankind 為了全人類的福祉
The invention of the Internet changed mankind forever.
(網際網路的發明永遠改變了人類。)
Climate change is a threat to all humankind.
(氣候變遷是全人類的威脅。)

marble(n.)大理石、彈珠
(無詞性變化)
marble floor 大理石地板
play marbles 玩彈珠
The hall has a beautiful marble floor.
(大廳有美麗的大理石地板。)
Taroko Gorge is famous for its marble cliffs.
(太魯閣峽谷以大理石峭壁聞名。)

march(n./v.)行軍、遊行、前進、示威遊行
(無詞性變化)
march past 列隊行進通過
peace march 和平遊行
The band marched down the street.
(樂隊沿著街道行進。)
Thousands of people joined the march.
(數千人參加了這場遊行。)

marker(n.)麥克筆、記號筆、標記
mark(v./n.)標記、記號
whiteboard marker 白板筆
permanent marker 油性筆
The teacher wrote on the board with a red marker.
(老師用紅色白板筆在白板上寫字。)
Write your name on the box with a permanent marker.
(用油性筆在箱子上寫下你的名字。)

marvelous(adj.)令人驚嘆的、非凡的、極好的
marvel(v./n.)驚嘆、奇蹟
marvelous view 絕佳的景色
marvelous idea 絕妙的主意
We had a marvelous time at the beach.
(我們在海邊玩得非常愉快。)
That's a marvelous idea!
(那真是個絕妙的主意！)

mathematical(adj.)數學的、精確的
mathematics(n.)數學
mathematician(n.)數學家
mathematical problem 數學問題
mathematical skills 數學能力
Coding requires good mathematical skills.
(寫程式需要良好的數學能力。)
He solved the mathematical problem in five minutes.
(他在五分鐘內解出了這道數學題。)

mayor(n.)市長
(無詞性變化)
the mayor of Taipei 台北市長
elect a mayor 選舉市長
The mayor visited our school yesterday.
(市長昨天參訪了我們學校。)
People will elect a new mayor next year.
(人們明年將選出新市長。)

meadow(n.)草地、牧草地
(無詞性變化)
green meadow 綠色草原
flower meadow 花草地
Cows were eating grass in the meadow.
(牛群在草地上吃草。)
We had a picnic in a meadow full of flowers.
(我們在開滿花的草地上野餐。)

meaningful(adj.)有意義的、意味深長的
meaning(n.)意義
meaningless(adj.)無意義的
meaningful experience 有意義的經驗
meaningful life 有意義的人生
Volunteering at the hospital was a meaningful experience.
(在醫院當志工是一段有意義的經驗。)
She gave me a meaningful look.
(她意味深長地看了我一眼。)

meanwhile(n./adv.)同時、其間
(無詞性變化)
in the meanwhile 在這期間
meanwhile at home 與此同時在家裡
Dad cooked dinner; meanwhile, I set the table.
(爸爸煮晚餐，同時我擺好餐具。)
The bus will come in twenty minutes. In the meanwhile, let's get a drink.
(公車二十分鐘後才來，這段時間我們去買杯飲料吧。)

medal(n.)獎牌、勳章
medalist(n.)獎牌得主
gold medal 金牌
win a medal 贏得獎牌
She won a gold medal at the Olympics.
(她在奧運贏得一面金牌。)
Every runner got a medal after the race.
(每位跑者賽後都獲得一面獎牌。)

medium(n.)媒介、方法、中間
media(n.)媒體(medium 的複數)
mass media 大眾傳播媒體
a medium of communication 溝通媒介
English is used as a medium of teaching in this class.
(這堂課用英文作為教學媒介。)
The mass media has a strong influence on young people.
(大眾媒體對年輕人有很大的影響。)

melon(n.)甜瓜、瓜
watermelon(n.)西瓜
slice of melon 一片瓜
honeydew melon 哈密瓜
We ate cold watermelon on a hot day.
(我們在大熱天吃冰涼的西瓜。)
This melon is sweet and juicy.
(這顆甜瓜又甜又多汁。)

melt(v.)融化、熔化、(感情)軟化
(無詞性變化)
melt away 逐漸消失
melting pot 大熔爐
The ice cream melted quickly in the sun.
(冰淇淋在陽光下很快就融化了。)
Her smile melted my heart.
(她的笑容融化了我的心。)

mend(v.)修補、修理、改善
(無詞性變化)
mend clothes 縫補衣服
mend a relationship 修補關係
Grandma mended the hole in my jeans.
(奶奶幫我補好牛仔褲上的破洞。)
They tried to mend their friendship after the fight.
(吵架後他們試著修補友誼。)

mental(adj.)心理的、精神的、智力的
mentally(adv.)心理上、精神上
mentality(n.)心態
mental health 心理健康
mental age 心智年齡
Exercise is good for both physical and mental health.
(運動對身心健康都有益。)
Taking the exam was a great mental challenge.
(考試是一大心理挑戰。)

merry(adj.)愉快的、歡樂的
merrily(adv.)愉快地
Merry Christmas 聖誕快樂
merry-go-round 旋轉木馬
We wish you a Merry Christmas!
(祝你聖誕快樂！)
The children laughed merrily on the merry-go-round.
(孩子們在旋轉木馬上開心地笑著。)

mess(n./v.)雜亂、混亂、弄亂
messy(adj.)凌亂的
in a mess 一團亂
mess up 弄亂、搞砸
Your room is in a mess!
(你的房間亂七八糟！)
I messed up my speech because I was nervous.
(我因為緊張把演講搞砸了。)

microphone(n.)麥克風
mike(n.)麥克風(口語)
speak into the microphone 對著麥克風講話
wireless microphone 無線麥克風
Please speak into the microphone so everyone can hear.
(請對著麥克風說話，這樣大家才聽得到。)
The singer held the mike and started to sing.
(那位歌手拿起麥克風開始唱歌。)

microwave(n./v.)微波爐、微波、用微波爐加熱
(無詞性變化)
microwave oven 微波爐
microwave food 微波食品
Heat the rice in the microwave for two minutes.
(把飯放進微波爐加熱兩分鐘。)
I microwaved my lunch at the convenience store.
(我在便利商店把午餐微波加熱。)

mighty(adj.)強大的、巨大的
might(n.)力量、權力
mightily(adv.)強而有力地
mighty river 大河
mighty power 強大的力量
The mighty river flows into the sea.
(那條大河流入大海。)
The pen is mightier than the sword.
(筆的力量勝過劍。)

minus(prep./n./adj.)減去、負號、零下的、負的
(無詞性變化)
minus sign 減號
minus ten degrees 零下十度
Ten minus four is six.
(十減四等於六。)
It was minus five degrees in Seoul last night.
(首爾昨晚氣溫零下五度。)

miracle(n.)奇蹟
miraculous(adj.)奇蹟般的
work miracles 創造奇蹟
by a miracle 奇蹟般地
It was a miracle that no one was hurt in the accident.
(那場車禍沒有人受傷真是奇蹟。)
The doctors worked miracles to save his life.
(醫生們創造奇蹟救回了他的性命。)

misery(n.)痛苦、悲慘、不幸
miserable(adj.)悲慘的、痛苦的
live in misery 生活悲慘
put someone out of misery 讓某人解脫
The war brought misery to millions of people.
(戰爭為數百萬人帶來苦難。)
Many families still live in misery after the earthquake.
(許多家庭在地震後仍過著悲慘的生活。)

missile(n.)飛彈、導彈
(無詞性變化)
launch a missile 發射飛彈
missile test 飛彈試射
The country launched a missile into the sea.
(該國向海上發射了一枚飛彈。)
The news reported a new missile test this morning.
(新聞報導今天早上有一次新的飛彈試射。)

missing(adj.)失蹤的、遺失的、缺少的
miss(v.)錯過、想念、遺漏
missing person 失蹤人口
go missing 失蹤、不見
My cat went missing last week.
(我的貓上週不見了。)
Two pages are missing from this book.
(這本書少了兩頁。)

mission(n.)任務、使命、使節團
missionary(n.)傳教士
on a mission 執行任務
mission impossible 不可能的任務
The astronauts completed their mission successfully.
(太空人們成功完成了他們的任務。)
Our mission is to help children in need.
(我們的使命是幫助需要幫助的孩子。)

mist(n./v.)薄霧、霧氣、起霧、(眼睛)變模糊
misty(adj.)有霧的、朦朧的
morning mist 晨霧
covered in mist 被霧籠罩
The mountains were covered in morning mist.
(群山被晨霧籠罩。)
Her eyes misted over when she said goodbye.
(她道別時眼眶泛起淚光。)

mob(n./v.)暴民、一群人、成群圍住
(無詞性變化)
angry mob 憤怒的群眾
be mobbed by fans 被粉絲團團圍住
An angry mob gathered outside the building.
(一群憤怒的群眾聚集在大樓外。)
The singer was mobbed by fans at the airport.
(那位歌手在機場被粉絲團團圍住。)

mobile(adj.)可移動的、行動的
mobility(n.)移動性、流動性
mobile phone 手機
mobile game 手機遊戲
Please turn off your mobile phone during the test.
(考試時請關掉你的手機。)
Many students spend hours playing mobile games.
(許多學生花好幾個小時玩手遊。)

moist(adj.)潮濕的、濕潤的
moisture(n.)濕氣、水分
moisten(v.)弄濕、使濕潤
moist soil 濕潤的土壤
moist air 潮濕的空氣
Keep the soil moist, but don't water the plant too much.
(保持土壤濕潤，但不要澆太多水。)
This chocolate cake is soft and moist.
(這個巧克力蛋糕鬆軟又濕潤。)

moisture(n.)濕氣、水分
moist(adj.)潮濕的
moisturize(v.)保濕
absorb moisture 吸收水分
lose moisture 流失水分
This cream helps your skin keep its moisture.
(這款乳霜幫助你的肌膚保持水分。)
Rice can absorb moisture from the air.
(米能吸收空氣中的濕氣。)

monk(n.)和尚、僧侶
(無詞性變化)
Buddhist monk 佛教僧侶
become a monk 出家
A Buddhist monk lives in the temple on the hill.
(一位僧侶住在山丘上的寺廟裡。)
He decided to become a monk at the age of thirty.
(他三十歲時決定出家。)

monster(n.)怪物、巨大的東西
monstrous(adj.)巨大的、駭人的
sea monster 海怪
little monster 小怪物、小搗蛋
The movie is about a monster living under the sea.
(這部電影是關於一隻住在海底的怪物。)
My little brother is a real monster when he's hungry.
(我弟弟肚子餓時真是個小搗蛋。)

monthly(adj./adv./n.)每月的、每月一次、月刊
month(n.)月
monthly payment 月付款
monthly magazine 月刊
My monthly phone bill is about five hundred dollars.
(我每月的電話費大約五百元。)
The club meets monthly to share books.
(讀書會每月聚會一次分享書籍。)

moral(adj./n.)道德的、寓意、道德規範
morality(n.)道德
morally(adv.)道德上
moral of the story 故事的寓意
moral support 精神支持
The moral of the story is that honesty is the best policy.
(這個故事的寓意是誠實為上策。)
My friends came to give me moral support.
(我的朋友們來給我精神上的支持。)

mosquito(n.)蚊子
(無詞性變化)
mosquito bite 蚊子叮咬
mosquito net 蚊帳
I got a lot of mosquito bites in the park.
(我在公園被蚊子叮了好多包。)
Mosquitoes can spread dengue fever.
(蚊子會傳播登革熱。)

mostly(adv.)大多、主要地
most(adj./adv.)大部分的、最
mostly sunny 大致晴朗
consist mostly of 主要由…組成
The weather will be mostly sunny tomorrow.
(明天天氣大致晴朗。)
The audience was mostly teenagers.
(觀眾大多是青少年。)

motel(n.)汽車旅館
(無詞性變化)
stay at a motel 住汽車旅館
cheap motel 便宜的汽車旅館
We stayed at a motel near the highway.
(我們住在公路附近的一間汽車旅館。)
The motel was cheap but clean.
(那間汽車旅館便宜又乾淨。)

moth(n.)蛾
(無詞性變化)
like a moth to a flame 飛蛾撲火般地
moth wings 蛾的翅膀
A moth flew around the lamp all night.
(一隻蛾整晚繞著燈飛。)
Fans were drawn to the star like moths to a flame.
(粉絲們像飛蛾撲火般被那位明星吸引。)

motor(n.)馬達、發動機
motorcycle(n.)機車、摩托車
electric motor 電動馬達
motor vehicle 機動車輛
The fan has a small electric motor.
(這台電風扇有一個小型電動馬達。)
The boat's motor stopped in the middle of the lake.
(船的馬達在湖中央熄火了。)

multiply(v.)乘、增加、繁殖
multiplication(n.)乘法、增加
multiply by 乘以
multiply rapidly 迅速增加
Three multiplied by four equals twelve.
(三乘以四等於十二。)
Bacteria multiply quickly in warm weather.
(細菌在溫暖的天氣中會迅速繁殖。)

murder(n./v.)謀殺、兇殺
murderer(n.)殺人兇手
commit murder 犯下謀殺罪
murder case 兇殺案
The police are investigating the murder case.
(警方正在調查這起兇殺案。)
The novel is about a murder on a train.
(這本小說是關於一起火車上的謀殺案。)

muscle(n.)肌肉、力量
muscular(adj.)肌肉發達的
build muscle 鍛鍊肌肉
pull a muscle 拉傷肌肉
He goes to the gym to build muscle.
(他去健身房鍛鍊肌肉。)
I pulled a muscle while playing basketball.
(我打籃球時拉傷了肌肉。)

mushroom(n./v.)蘑菇、迅速增長
(無詞性變化)
mushroom soup 蘑菇湯
wild mushroom 野生菇類
Never eat wild mushrooms you can't identify.
(千萬不要吃無法辨識的野生菇類。)
Coffee shops have mushroomed in our neighborhood.
(我們這一區的咖啡店如雨後春筍般冒出來。)

mystery(n.)謎、神祕的事物、推理小說
mysterious(adj.)神祕的
solve a mystery 解開謎團
mystery novel 推理小說
How the pyramids were built is still a mystery.
(金字塔是如何建造的至今仍是一個謎。)
She loves reading mystery novels.
(她很愛看推理小說。)

naked(adj.)裸體的、赤裸的、無遮蔽的
(無詞性變化)
naked eye 肉眼
naked truth 赤裸裸的事實
Some stars can be seen with the naked eye.
(有些星星用肉眼就看得見。)
The baby ran around the room naked after his bath.
(那個寶寶洗完澡後光著身子在房間裡跑來跑去。)

nap(n./v.)小睡、午睡、打盹
(無詞性變化)
take a nap 小睡一下
afternoon nap 午睡
I usually take a short nap after lunch.
(我通常午餐後小睡一下。)
Grandpa is napping on the sofa.
(爺爺正在沙發上打盹。)

napkin(n.)餐巾、餐巾紙
(無詞性變化)
paper napkin 紙巾
fold a napkin 摺餐巾
Could you pass me a napkin, please?
(可以請你遞給我一張餐巾紙嗎？)
He wiped his mouth with a paper napkin.
(他用紙巾擦嘴。)

native(adj./n.)本國的、出生地的、本地人
(無詞性變化)
native speaker 母語人士
native language 母語
Our English teacher is a native speaker from Canada.
(我們的英文老師是來自加拿大的母語人士。)
Formosan black bears are native to Taiwan.
(台灣黑熊是台灣的原生物種。)

navy(n.)海軍、海軍藍
naval(adj.)海軍的
join the navy 加入海軍
navy blue 海軍藍、深藍色
My uncle served in the navy for ten years.
(我叔叔在海軍服役了十年。)
Our school uniform is navy blue.
(我們的校服是深藍色的。)

neat(adj.)整潔的、整齊的、很棒的
neatly(adv.)整齊地
neat and tidy 整齊乾淨
neat handwriting 工整的字跡
Her room is always neat and tidy.
(她的房間總是整齊乾淨。)
Your handwriting is very neat.
(你的字跡非常工整。)

necessity(n.)必需品、必要性
necessary(adj.)必要的
necessarily(adv.)必然地
daily necessities 日常必需品
out of necessity 出於必要
Water and food are basic necessities of life.
(水和食物是生活的基本必需品。)
Smartphones have become a necessity for students.
(智慧型手機已成為學生的必需品。)

necktie(n.)領帶
tie(n./v.)領帶、綁
wear a necktie 打領帶
tie a necktie 繫領帶
Dad wears a necktie to work every day.
(爸爸每天打領帶上班。)
I bought my father a necktie for Father's Day.
(我買了一條領帶送爸爸當父親節禮物。)

neighborhood(n.)鄰近地區、街坊、社區
neighbor(n.)鄰居
in the neighborhood 在附近
quiet neighborhood 安靜的社區
Is there a post office in the neighborhood?
(這附近有郵局嗎？)
We live in a quiet neighborhood.
(我們住在一個安靜的社區。)

nest(n./v.)巢、窩、築巢
(無詞性變化)
bird's nest 鳥巢
build a nest 築巢
Two birds are building a nest in the tree.
